verdict.rationale: Reclaim applies automation across many calendar items at once: it auto-schedules and reschedules events around priorities, auto-categorizes all events, and the 2.0 Schedule Assistant lets you preview a set of changes before deploying them. None of this is documented as user-initiated bulk editing of selected items, and the auth-gated MCP endpoint with a write scope has no documented bulk tools. Missing for 10: explicit bulk select/edit/delete of tasks or events, documented batch actions via the AI assistant or API/MCP, and hands-on corroboration of multi-item operations.
